This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! These are the kinds of meals that end up on repeat in my kitchen because they’re easy, comforting, and just so good🥰 Ingredients 🐓🍝🥗 One pot chicken & pasta 1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs/breast 1 onion, sliced ¼ cup olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon garlic powder ½ teaspoon black pepper 1 package 16 oz penne pasta  4 cups chicken broth or any broth you love ½ cup tomato paste Side salad 🥒🍅🥑 4 Persian cucumbers, chopped About a cup of cherry tomatoes  1 shallot  1 avocado  Olive oil Fresh lemon juice  Fresh lime juice  Salt and pepper Instructions Place the chicken thighs in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix until evenly coated. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side until golden. Scatter the sliced onion right over the chicken and let it soften in all the flavor. Pour the tomato broth mixture right over the chicken and pasta and bring everything to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the chicken is fully cooked through. While everything cooks, chop the cucumbers cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, shallot, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon and lime juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss. That’s it. Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice This Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice is a cozy, comforting dinner featuring juicy golden chicken served over fluffy rice with a rich, buttery Parmesan garlic sauce. It's simple enough for busy weeknights but delicious enough to feel like a special homemade meal. Ingredients • 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins • 3 cups cooked white rice • 2 tablespoons olive oil • 3 tablespoons butter • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning • 1/2 teaspoon paprika • 1/2 teaspoon onion powder • Salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Instructions Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter in the same skillet. Add the garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the chicken broth and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Add the heavy cream and let the sauce simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in the Parmesan cheese until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. Simmer for another 2 minutes. Serve the chicken over warm cooked rice and drizzle generously with the creamy garlic butter sauce. Finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. Chicken Alfredo Tortellini Soup This soup is an easy one-pot dinner that’s perfect for a cozy night!  Ingredients 1 lb chicken breast, cubed 2 tbsp butter 1 sweet onion, diced 3 large carrots, diced Salt and black pepper, to taste 1 tsp garlic powder 1/4 cup all-purpose flour 4 cups chicken stock 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half 18 oz cheese tortellini 1 (6 oz) bag shredded Parmesan cheese 3 cups fresh spinach 1 tsp crushed red pepper flakes Directions 1. Melt the butter in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the diced onion and carrots. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and poultry seasoning. Cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables begin to soften. 2. Sprinkle the flour over the vegetables and stir well until everything is evenly coated. Cook for 1–2 minutes. 3. Slowly pour in the chicken stock, stirring continuously to incorporate the flour and create a smooth broth. 4. Add the cubed chicken breast and bring the broth to a boil. Reduce the heat to a simmer and cook until the chicken is cooked through.  5. Stir in the heavy cream or half-and-half, followed by the cheese tortellini. Cook according to the package directions until the tortellini are tender. 6. Reduce the heat to low and gradually stir in the shredded Parmesan cheese until melted and the soup is creamy. 7. Add the fresh spinach and crushed red pepper flakes. Stir for 1–2 minutes, or until the spinach is wilted. 8. Remove from the heat and let the soup sit for about 10–15 minutes before serving. This gives the soup time to thicken and allows all those flavors to come together. Serve warm with extra Parmesan and crushed red pepper on top! Recipe Note The tortellini will continue to soak up the broth as the soup sits, so don't worry if it initially looks a little thinner than you'd like. It will thicken considerably as it rests. If you have leftovers, the tortellini will continue absorbing liquid overnight in the refrigerator. When reheating, simply add a splash of chicken stock, milk, half-and-half, or cream to loosen the soup back up to your desired consistency. #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #soupseason #easydinner #quickrecipes

🧀 Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans 🍗🥔 This Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans is an easy sheet-pan dinner packed with bold flavor. Juicy oven-roasted chicken is coated in a crispy Parmesan crust, while buttery garlic potatoes and tender green beans roast alongside for a complete, satisfying family meal with minimal cleanup. Ingredients For the Chicken • 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts • 2 tbsp olive oil • ¾ cup grated Parmesan cheese • ½ cup panko breadcrumbs • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • ½ tsp smoked paprika • ¾ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper For the Potatoes • 1½ lbs baby Yukon Gold potatoes, halved • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp melted butter • 1 tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp paprika • Salt and black pepper, to taste For the Green Beans • 12 oz fresh green beans, trimmed • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp melted butter • Salt and black pepper, to taste For Garnish • 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley • Lemon wedges Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Lightly grease a large sheet pan or line it with parchment paper. 2. Toss the potatoes with olive oil, melted butter, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Spread them evenly on one side of the pan and roast for 15 minutes. 3. In a shallow bowl, combine the Parmesan cheese, panko breadcrumbs, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. 4. Brush both sides of the chicken breasts with olive oil, then press them firmly into the Parmesan mixture until well coated. 5. Remove the sheet pan from the oven and move the potatoes to one side. Arrange the coated chicken in the center. 6. Toss the green beans with olive oil, melted butter, minced garlic, salt, and pepper, then place them beside the chicken. 7. Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) and the potatoes are fork-tender. 8. Switch the oven to broil and cook for 2–3 minutes until the Parmesan crust is extra crispy and golden. 9. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve with lemon wedges. Serving Suggestions Serve with Caesar salad, garlic bread, roasted carrots, steamed broccoli, or creamy ranch dipping sauce for a complete restaurant-style dinner. Storage Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days. Reheat in the oven or air fryer to keep the chicken crispy. One Pan Chicken Yakisoba Ingredients * 1–1¼ lb (450–570 g) chicken tenders, trimmed and cut into bite-size pieces * 2 packages (7.32 oz each) precooked yakisoba noodles, 14.64 oz (415 g) total * 1 bag (12–16 oz / 340–450 g) frozen stir-fry vegetables * 3 tbsp vegetable or avocado oil, divided * 2 cloves garlic, minced Sauce * ½ cup (120 mL) reduced-sodium soy sauce * ¼ cup (50 g) packed brown sugar * 2 tbsp (30 mL) regular or toasted sesame oil * 2 tsp ground ginger * ¼–½ tsp crushed red pepper flakes, optional * 1 tbsp (8 g) cornstarch * 2 tbsp (30 mL) water Optional Garnishes: Sliced green onions, sesame seeds and chopped peanuts Instructions 1. Prepare the sauce: In a small bowl, whisk together reduced-sodium soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, ginger and red pepper flakes, if using. Set aside. 2. Cook the chicken: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large, deep skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned and cooked through to 165°F (74°C). Transfer to a plate. 3. Cook the vegetables: Add remaining 1 tbsp oil to the same skillet. Add frozen vegetables and cook for 5–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until heated through and excess moisture has evaporated. 4. Add garlic: Stir in minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds, until fragrant. 5. Add noodles: Add both packages of precooked yakisoba noodles and cook for 1–2 minutes, stirring gently. 6. Combine: Return chicken and any accumulated juices to the skillet. Pour in the prepared sauce and toss until everything is evenly coated. 7. Thicken the sauce: In a small bowl, whisk together cornstarch and water until smooth. Immediately pour into the skillet and toss gently over medium heat for 1–2 minutes, until the sauce comes to a simmer and lightly thickens. 8. Serve: Remove from heat and garnish with sliced green onions, sesame seeds and chopped peanuts, if desired. #chickenyakisoba #easyrecipe #easydinner   #easyandfastdinnerideas #onepanmeal
